mainEntity.name: Are subscriptions and memberships better than one-time AI-created products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recurring revenue is possible when customers continue receiving value, but automation does not make a subscription worthwhile by itself. Run My AI Biz’s examples include paid newsletters, memberships, recurring operational services, and ongoing business support workflows. Key factors are the frequency of customer need, retention drivers, delivery cost, support burden, cancellation reasons, and whether the offer improves over time. Define exactly what members receive and how often before choosing a recurring price. Start with a small founding group or limited pilot and monitor retention and support requests. Do not promise continual access or results unless the underlying tools, content, and service capacity can support it.
acceptedAnswer.description: Neither is automatically better. Subscriptions can create recurring revenue but require ongoing value, support, retention, and reliable delivery; one-time products are simpler to fulfill but may require continual acquisition. Choose based on customer need frequency, maintenance capacity, and delivery costs.
